items.title: Steve Gilmore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Delaware Water Gap, PA, November 8, 1999
items.q: attended Oscar Peterson’s Advanced School of Contemporary Music

ctx.x: Bassist Steve Gilmore was born in Trenton, NJ on January 21, 1943. He was working professionally while still in his teens, attended Oscar Peterson’s Advanced School of Contemporary Music and gained experience with Ira Sullivan and Flip Phillips while living in Florida. Steve freelanced in the northeast in the seventies, performing with the Thad Jones-Mel Lewis Orchestra, Mose Allison and Toshiko Akiyoshi. Steve was interviewed in Delaware Water Gap, PA on November 8, 1999, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
